title: [non-sota] PR #1851/#1855 lineage ablation: Spellgram/Inhibition/Frozen-Projection
author: cloud-777-boy
body:
Adds a non-record Parameter Golf derivative/ablation submission.

This submission is based on the PR #1851 / PR #1855 lineage, with attribution. It does not claim a new leaderboard record.

Experimental changes:
- Frozen projection / frozen MLP component in layer 7
- Spellgram/Spellingbee hash-based legal n-gram memory at layer 0 / embedding entry
- Inhibitory layer in the middle of the model, on layer 5

Due to last-minute compute constraints and RunPod availability issues, final validation could not be fully completed before the deadline. The available code, notes, and lineage references are included transparently.

If this is not appropriate for record consideration, please treat it as a non-record derivative/ablation artifact.

Thanks to the authors of the prior submissions this builds on.
